The '''''Armored Fist''''' was a decommissioned [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] acquired by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He used it as a mobile command bunker during the [[Battle of Whisper Base]] before being defeated by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] agents.
